# BCF 3.0 schemas (vendored, unmodified)

The XML schemas of BCF-XML 3.0 by buildingSMART International, copied byte for
byte from https://github.com/buildingSMART/BCF-XML/tree/release_3_0/Schemas
(commit release_3_0 head, fetched 2026-10-30).

Used by `bff/bim/bcf3-build.spec.ts`, which validates every file of an
exported archive with `xmllint --schema`.
